{{Top|leg}}
An '''infrared guide stick''' was an optional extra that could be used with the [[Mark V14 baggage handler]]. Costing an additional 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the palm sized controller could be used to remotely guide the baggage handler.
